name: Contract: Kill Thonar Silver-Blood
plugin: Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp
canDoWhy: An extra Dark Brotherhood contract you accept, then report back to Nazir in the Falkreath Sanctuary.

needs.what: Be a member of the Dark Brotherhood

starts.where: the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath
starts.how: Accept the additional contract to kill Thonar Silver-Blood; Nazir is the one who pays you when it's done.

rewards.what: A leveled reward item (large quest reward)

people.name: Thonar Silver-Blood
people.role: the target; placed in the Treasury House in Markarth, where his daily routine keeps him

people.name: Nazir
people.role: pays you at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary

unsure.why: The records don't show the line that sets the contract going. The extract's giver line is spoken by Thonar while the contract is fresh (likely something he says to you as the target), and Nazir has lines up to the reward. Nazir handing it out is the best reading, not confirmed.
No start condition is in these files; Dark Brotherhood membership is inferred from the contract going through Nazir.
Thonar's record is marked essential in these files; how the mod lets you kill him isn't shown.

evidence: Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000FDA
giver info ACDB:000FDD (GetIsID Thonar, stage<11); Nazir Skyrim.esm:01C3AB stage<101

name: LTN Quest Handler
canDoWhy: The Listen mod's behind-the-scenes quest that hands out the Night Mother's contracts; never shown in the journal.
opens: Contract: Kill the target (Markarth, Riften, Solitude, Whiterun and Windhelm versions)

unsure.why: Its only stage text is 'Give the player contracts' and it holds a talking object; that it starts the five Listen contracts is inferred from the mod's quest list, not shown as a link.

evidence: stage 0 'Startup stage', stage 10 'Give the player contracts.'

name: Contract: Kill the target
canDoWhy: A repeatable Night Mother contract from the Listen mod; the target is picked by the game and the payment waits at the Markarth dead drop.

needs.what: Be the Listener, able to hear the Night Mother

starts.where: her coffin, wherever the Dark Brotherhood's Night Mother rests
starts.how: The Night Mother hands you a contract; the journal says she has tasked you with a kill and that payment was left the Markarth Dead Drop.

firstStep: Kill the target named in your journal

takesYou.why: kill the target; the game picks who

choices.leadsTo: Kill the target and take the payment from the dead drop (either order); the contract completes.

choices.choice: Hand the contract to another Dark Brotherhood member
choices.leadsTo: They do the job and take the payment themselves; you get nothing from the dead drop.

objectives: Retrieve payment from the Markarth Dead Drop.

rewards.what: Gold (amount not given in these files)
A leveled reward item (medium quest reward)

opens: More Night Mother contracts (the journal tells you to return to her for more)

people.name: The Night Mother
people.role: gives the contract

people.name: Festus Krex, Babette, Adelinda or a Dark Brotherhood Initiate
people.role: can take the contract off your hands

unsure.why: The giver line in the extract is spoken by Festus Krex, Babette, Adelinda or an Initiate while the contract is still open; that fits the hand-off to another member, not the start. The journal says the Night Mother gives it, and the Listen handler quest uses a talking object (her coffin, most likely). Where her coffin stands isn't in these files.
No start condition is in these files; being the Listener is inferred from the Night Mother giving the contract.
The target is filled at random and the dead drop is not a named place in these files; only the journal's wording gives its rough location.

The gold and leveled item come from the quest script; the amount and whether they sit in the dead drop or go straight to you aren't shown. Handing the job off has no completion mark, so it may give nothing at all.

evidence: giver info Listen.esp:00082C (GetIsID Festus Krex/Babette/Initiate/Adelinda, stage<11)

name: The Dark Brotherhood Forever
plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by LoreRim - Global Modifiers.esp)
canDoWhy: Once you lead the Dark Brotherhood as Listener, the Night Mother keeps sending you to a contact who names a target, over and over.

needs.what: Become the Listener and leader of the Dark Brotherhood (end of its story)

starts.where: her coffin in the Dark Brotherhood's sanctuary
starts.how: Approach the Night Mother and listen; she names a contact somewhere in Skyrim.

people.name: The Night Mother
people.role: names each new contact

people.name: Nazir
people.role: part of the quest; placed in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath

people.name: Contacts (Nervous Patron, Wary Outlaw, Corrupt Agent, Scheming Servant, Desperate Gambler, Blasphemous Priest, Dishonored Skald, Indolent Farmer, Griefstricken Chef, Unemployed Laborer)
people.role: give you the name of a target

people.name: Targets: Visiting Noble (Dragonsreach, Whiterun), Big Laborer (Katla's Farm), Itinerant Lumberjack (Morthal), Reckless Mage (The Frozen Hearth, Winterhold), Seasoned Hunter (Falkreath), Poor Fishwife (Riften), Grim Shieldmaiden (Markarth), Traveling Dignitary (Solitude), Coldhearted Gravedigger (Hall of the Dead, Windhelm), Beautiful Barbarian (Ivarstead)
people.role: the people you may be sent to kill

unsure.why: What starts it isn't in these files; the journal's 'I am now the Listener and leader of the Dark Brotherhood' is what points to the end of the guild's story (Hail Sithis!).
Which sanctuary holds the Night Mother's coffin at that point isn't shown for this quest.

These are where the ten contacts and targets are placed; which pair you get each time, and which target goes with which contact, isn't shown. Their editor names hint at other towns (for example the Nervous Patron's names Dawnstar), so the placements may not be where they wait during the quest.
No reward is listed in these files for this quest.

Edited by Unofficial Skyrim Modders Patch, Listen.esp and LoreRim - Global Modifiers; the last is taken as the winner from the order listed. What Listen changes here isn't shown; it may replace or sit beside this with its own Night Mother contracts.

evidence: aliases NightMotherAlias, NMCoffinAlias, Contact1-10, Target1-10, NazirAlias

people.role: the one to talk to about joining; in Castle Dour by day

people.name: General Tullius
people.role: commands the Legion in Castle Dour

people.name: Galmar Stone-Fist
people.role: part of the quest; in the Palace of the Kings, Windhelm

unsure.why: No journal text, and the records don't show what puts the note in your journal; Rikke's line is the only one tied to it, before it ends.
Joining the Legion (Rikke's Fort Hraggstad task) is the natural next step, but no direct link is in these files.
Galmar is part of this quest, likely so joining the Stormcloaks ends it; not shown.
